intentEvidence: Note Loom is an Obsidian plugin that turns free-form notes into structured notes using your own templates.
motivation: Many Obsidian setups do not need more templates. They need a path from Inbox notes to finished notes.
problem: Users struggle with manually moving loose, free-form notes from an inbox into predefined structured systems like project trackers or journals.
summary: Note Loom transforms free-form Markdown notes into structured documents using custom templates, fields, tables, and checklists.
